description: Clear individual ownership, specific metric outcome, explicit tradeoff reasoning, and brief reflection on what they would do differently.
evalCriteria: Should detect clear individual ownership of the technical decision.
Should flag explicit tradeoff reasoning for the chosen solution.
Should rate the ability to articulate a specific metric outcome as weak or missing if not mentioned.
Should identify evidence of reflection on what they would do differently in a similar situation.
Should ask evidence recovery questions about the candidate's experience with ambiguity and uncertainty.

inputs.[PASTE BEHAVIORAL QUESTION]: Tell me about a time you drove an ambiguous technical decision under uncertainty.
inputs.[PASTE YOUR ANSWER]: When leading our team's migration to cloud-based services, I recognized that we had two competing requirements: meet the customer's deadline and ensure robust security. After discussing with stakeholders, I decided to prioritize security by investing additional resources upfront. This choice resulted in a 15% reduction in security incidents over the next quarter. In retrospect, I would have benefited from involving more team members in the decision-making process to better understand their perspectives.
inputs.[PASTE ROLE TITLE, KEY REQUIREMENTS, OR: Developing and implementing scalable software solutions for our cloud-based services team. Key requirements include driving technical decisions under uncertainty, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering high-quality results within tight timelines.
inputs.[OPTIONAL CONTEXT — layoff, promotion ta: Career progression within the company. Seeking to take on more senior responsibilities and contribute to the team's technical growth.
